answer: Admission is not a free keypair: a candidate must park a bond in an elevated mesa vault that cannot disburse until two unrelated established agents each open a time-staggered work bridge to it, with disjoint counterparty graphs. The bond is posted in saffron, a slowly issued scarce dye-token minted only against verified unique work. If later clustering shows shared funding or lockstep keys, both bridges collapse and the saffron burns, so a farm must spend real dye and recruit real independent collaborators for every alias.
